name: motion-orbit-turntable
title: Orbit / Turntable
description: Các thẻ chạy vòng quanh một tâm, thẻ phía sau nhỏ và tối hơn, thứ tự trước sau đổi đúng theo chiều sâu.

moworks.author: takayu

options.tilt: the circle's flattening, y radius ÷ x radius (0.2)

credit.author: TakayuStudio (motion-reference)
credit.licence: No licence stated: idea and numbers only
credit.madeNote: written here from the idea and its numbers; none of the source's code

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio cam-orbit, written here): 6 cards (44 x 60, one accent) on a circle: x = centre + 110 cos(a), y = centre + 22 sin(a), depth z = sin(a); scale 0.6 -> 1 and opacity 0.45 -> 1 from back to front; drawing order sorted by z every frame; angle 0 -> 360 deg over 4000 ms linear, seamless loop. Params: count (6) · radius (110 px) · period (4 s).
